name: Research a question in the Vault
description: Deeply research a handed-off question by re-searching and reading the Vault without modifying it.
prompt: 完成本次 vault-research。把调用方提供的 HandoffPacket 当作线索，先用 notemd search 验证并扩展候选来源，再读取必要原文；需要长期上下文时按根 AGENTS.md 通过 Memory context broker 授权。只读研究，不修改 Vault。
